
# Imaging Across the United States

## How Does Outpatient Imaging Differ Across Hospitals?

Medical imaging is an important part of modern healthcare. Hospitals use imaging technologies such as X-rays, CT scans, MRIs, and ultrasounds to help diagnose medical conditions.

However, imaging services and performance measures can vary between hospitals.

This project examines outpatient imaging data from hospitals across the United States using publicly available CMS data.

## Why Does This Matter?

Understanding differences in outpatient imaging can help patients and healthcare professionals learn more about hospital performance, imaging services, and healthcare quality.

The data can also help identify patterns and differences between hospitals.
